uncited: The Infinitesimal Strain Tensor is the symmetric counterpart to the Infinitesimal Rotation Tensor.
Use the Infinitesimal Strain Tensor when analyzing volume changes, shearing, or stretching in a medium under small deformation assumptions.
In such cases, the Lagrangian Strain Tensor should be used instead.
- **Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
- **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
It is part of the decomposition of the displacement gradient (Jacobian) into symmetric (strain) and antisymmetric (rotation) parts.
